headline_marked: Humayun Ahmed's [[14th death anniversary observed]] across Bangladesh
headline: Humayun Ahmed's 14th death anniversary observed across Bangladesh
summary: Fans and family remember the legendary writer as prayers, food distribution for orphans, and literary discussions take place in Gazipur and Netrakona.
details: Today marks the 14th death anniversary of the renowned writer Humayun Ahmed. To honor his memory, a Milad Mahfil, Quran recitation, and prayer meetings were held in Nuhash Polli, Gazipur.
The commemorations included the distribution of food among orphans and floral tributes paid by fans who gathered to express their love and respect for the beloved author.
In Netrakona's Kendua Upazila, the anniversary was observed at the Shahid Smriti Bidyapith, an educational institution founded by the author in his ancestral village of Kutubpur.
Teachers, students, and admirers paid their respects with floral tributes and wore black badges to mark the day. A special 'Himu Reader's Chat' event was also organized at the district press club.
Born on November 13, 1948, in Kutubpur, Humayun Ahmed was one of Bangladesh's most influential writers. He passed away on July 19, 2012, after battling cancer.
caption:
14 years since the loss of a literary icon. Bangladesh remembers Humayun Ahmed today.

Today marks the 14th death anniversary of the renowned writer Humayun Ahmed. To honor his memory, a Milad Mahfil, Quran recitation, and prayer meetings were held in Nuhash Polli, Gazipur.

The commemorations included the distribution of food among orphans and floral tributes paid by fans who gathered to express their love and respect for the beloved author.

In Netrakona's Kendua Upazila, the anniversary was observed at the Shahid Smriti Bidyapith, an educational institution founded by the author in his ancestral village of Kutubpur.

Teachers, students, and admirers paid their respects with floral tributes and wore black badges to mark the day. A special 'Himu Reader's Chat' event was also organized at the district press club.

Born on November 13, 1948, in Kutubpur, Humayun Ahmed was one of Bangladesh's most influential writers. He passed away on July 19, 2012, after battling cancer.

headline_marked: 4 more lives lost to [[measles-like symptoms]] in Bangladesh
headline: 4 more lives lost to measles-like symptoms in Bangladesh
summary: Health authorities are monitoring the situation as more deaths are reported linked to symptoms resembling measles.
details: Four more people have died from symptoms resembling those of measles, raising concerns about a potential outbreak in the country.
The deaths have been reported as part of a growing number of cases exhibiting these specific symptoms.
Health officials are currently investigating the cause of the deaths to determine if it is indeed measles or another similar illness.
Public health authorities are urging citizens to remain vigilant and ensure children are up to date with their vaccinations.
caption:
4 more deaths reported. Symptoms resembling measles are claiming lives.

Four more people have died from symptoms resembling those of measles, raising concerns about a potential outbreak in the country.

The deaths have been reported as part of a growing number of cases exhibiting these specific symptoms.

Health officials are currently investigating the cause of the deaths to determine if it is indeed measles or another similar illness.

Public health authorities are urging citizens to remain vigilant and ensure children are up to date with their vaccinations.
